component.name: Trace Commons
component.summary: Review and contribute your coding sessions

description.p: Trace Commons contributes the sessions you have with coding agents to an open corpus, with your explicit consent for each one. Nothing leaves your machine until you have seen exactly what it contains.
The application watches the session folders you nominate, and nothing else. It will not guess: until you say which folders to watch, it watches none of them.
Every session is scanned for secrets and personal information and shown to you in full before anything is sent. You decide per session, or arm a project you trust to contribute without asking.
The history screen now updates when a submission lands, instead of showing the counts it had at launch.

The queue no longer builds a preview for every waiting session at once, so opening the app does not pin the machine. Large sessions render without freezing, and queue rows are created as they scroll into view.
Submit a trace from the queue row, or every trace in a project, without opening the preview first. Opening a very large session no longer freezes the window.
Submit a trace straight from the queue, or every trace in a project, without opening the preview first. Session scanning now streams files instead of reading them whole.
